βύσσος , ἡ,
A.flax, and the linen made from it, Emp. 93 , Theoc. 2.73 , etc.; used of perennial flax, Linum angustifolium, grown in Elis, Paus. 6.26.6 , and of Linum usitatissimum, = λίνον Ἑβραίων , Id. 5.5.2 ; also, in later writers, of Indian cotton, Gossypium herbaceum, Poll. 7.76 , Philostr. VA 2.20 ; and of silk, “τὰ Σηρικὰ ἔκ τινων φλοιῶν ξαινουένης βύσσου”
Str. 15.1.20
.
From A Greek-English Lexicon (Henry George Liddell, Robert Scott, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1940)
